text: There are slender brown bugs on the rice grain heads and the whole field smells bad
Maraming atangya sa palay namin, maliliit at walang laman ang mga butil
Nakita ko ang atangya sa uhay ng palay, mabaho ang palayan
Mga butil sa uhay nagkulubot ug walay sulod, naay dangaw
Black shield-shaped bugs at the base of the rice plants and the leaves are turning reddish brown
May itim na atangya sa paanan ng palay at parang nasusunog ang bukid
Rice black bug outbreak, the field looks burned, bug burn everywhere
Small green leafhoppers jump when I shake the rice plants, and the leaves turn yellow-orange and stunted
May tungro ang palay namin, bansot at kulay dalandan ang dahon
Berdeng ngusong kabayo sa palay, dilaw at bansot ang mga halaman
The rice leaves are rolled into tubes and there are white transparent streaks, a caterpillar is inside
Nakabilot ang mga dahon ng palay at may puting guhit, magbibilot yata ito
Leaf tips of the rice are cut as if with scissors and small tube cases are floating on the water
May mambibilot sa palayan, pinutol ang dulo ng dahon at may lumulutang na supot sa tubig
Harabas sa palay, pinutol ang uhay at nalaglag sa lupa
Armyworms cut the rice panicles at the base and they fall to the ground, they feed at night
Tiny holes and white streaks at the edge of the young rice leaves, langaw palay
Stunted young corn with leaves turning yellow then black, and corn planthoppers on the plants
May ngusong kabayo sa mais, bansot ang halaman at may malagkit na dahon
Worms at the tip of the corn ear eating the silk and the kernels, lots of droppings
May uod sa puso ng mais, kinain ang silk at ang dulo ng butil
Harabas sa mais, kinain hanggang gitnang ugat ang mga dahon at gabi sila kumakain
The corn leaves are eaten down to the midrib by striped caterpillars that feed at night, armyworm
Aphids on the corn tassel and silk, sticky with black sooty mold and ants walking on it
Maraming aplat sa tassel ng mais, malagkit at may langgam
Young corn plants are cut at ground level and there are gaps in the rows, I think cutworm
Naputol sa lupa ang mga bagong tanim na mais, may puwang sa hanay, cutworm yata
Rice stem borer, aksip, dead hearts that pull out easily
Brown planthopper sa palay, ngusong kabayo ang tawag dito dito sa amin, nasunog ang bilog na bahagi
Fall armyworm in the corn whorl with sawdust-like frass
Asian corn borer tunnels in the corn stalk, broken tassel
